regions.today: Dry today with spells of sunshine through the morning. Very warm or hot with highest temperatures of 24 to 28 degrees in light westerly winds.
regions.tonight: Remaining dry tonight with clear skies at first. Cloud will increase from the west later. Some mist and fog will develop also. Mild with lowest temperatures of 12 to 15 degrees in a light variable breeze.
regions.tomorrow: Quite cloudy at first tomorrow with mist and fog patches. These will quickly clear to leave a dry day with spells of sunshine. Very warm with highest temperatures of 24 to 28 degrees, possibly higher locally, in light variable winds.
